item.description:
### Changed - **Messages you send from your phone stay private on the Mac.** Until now the text was typed into the terminal in a way that briefly showed it to any other user account on the same Mac while it was being sent. It is now handed to the terminal directly, and never appears there.
### Added - **Multi-line messages from your phone.** Pasting or dictating text with line breaks used to be refused. It now arrives in the agent as one message with its line breaks intact, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin and Amp — each one was checked by hand first. (The Return key on the phone keyboard still sends; line breaks arrive by paste or dictation.)
### Fixed - **Sending from the phone is a little quicker.** Long messages, and every message to Codex, used to pause briefly before submitting to make sure the agent had caught up. The new way of handing over text made that unnecessary, which was confirmed with 40 test sends before the pause was removed.
